instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to know the number of patients prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'lipitor.' You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients → one hundred and twenty-three). If no patients are prescribed under the exact name 'lipitor,' you want to ask the same question using medications whose name contains its generic name.
gold_sql: WITH LipitorPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT patientid FROM medicationorders WHERE medicationname = 'lipitor' ), AtorvastatinPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT patientid FROM medicationorders WHERE medicationname LIKE '%atorvastatin%' ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LipitorPatients) THEN (SELECT COUNT(patientid) FROM LipitorPatients) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(patientid) FROM AtorvastatinPatients) END AS final_count;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to find the average hospital admission age of heart failure patients prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'lasix.' When calculating patient ages, you want to include each patient's age only once, based on the age recorded at their earliest hospital admission where a heart failure diagnosis and Lasix prescription both occurred. You want the result rounded to four decimal places. If no patients were prescribed medication under the exact name 'lasix,' you want to repeat the same question using medications containing Lasix's generic name.
gold_sql: WITH valid_heart_failure_codes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.icdcode, d.codeversion, di.description FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN diagnosiscodes di ON d.icdcode = di.icdcode AND d.codeversion = di.codeversion WHERE ((d.icdcode LIKE '428%' AND d.codeversion = 9) OR (d.icdcode LIKE 'i50%' AND d.codeversion = 10)) ), first_hf_diagnosis AS ( SELECT d.patientid, d.admissionid, MIN(d.recordeddatetime) AS first_hf_time FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN valid_heart_failure_codes hfd ON d.icdcode = hfd.icdcode AND d.codeversion = hfd.codeversion GROUP BY d.patientid, d.admissionid ), lasix_ranked AS ( SELECT a.patientid, a.age AS admission_age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.patientid ORDER BY a.admitdatetime ) AS rn FROM hospitaladmissions a JOIN first_hf_diagnosis f ON a.admissionid = f.admissionid JOIN medicationorders p ON a.admissionid = p.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname = 'lasix' AND p.startdatetime >= f.first_hf_time ), lasix_admissions AS ( SELECT admission_age FROM lasix_ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), furosemide_ranked AS ( SELECT a.patientid, a.age AS admission_age, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.patientid ORDER BY a.admitdatetime ) AS rn FROM hospitaladmissions a JOIN first_hf_diagnosis f ON a.admissionid = f.admissionid JOIN medicationorders p ON a.admissionid = p.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname = 'furosemide' AND p.startdatetime >= f.first_hf_time ), furosemide_admissions AS ( SELECT admission_age FROM furosemide_ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), combined_ages AS ( SELECT admission_age FROM lasix_admissions WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lasix_admissions) UNION ALL SELECT admission_age FROM furosemide_admissions WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lasix_admissions) ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(admission_age), 4) AS average_age FROM combined_ages;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to find the most common diagnosis name received by patients prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'vancocin' during the same hospital admission. If multiple results tie for the highest frequency, you want to retrieve all of them. If a patient has multiple records of Vancocin across hospital admissions, you only want the first Vancocin record among them. If a patient has multiple records of the same diagnosis name, you want to count them only once per hospital admission. You want the answer to be based on the exact diagnosis name recorded in the database. If no patients were prescribed medication under the exact name 'vancocin,' you want to repeat the same question using medications whose name contains Vancocin's generic name
gold_sql: WITH VancocinCheck AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS vancocin_count FROM medicationorders WHERE medicationname = 'vancocin' ), FirstPrescription AS ( SELECT mo.patientid, mo.admissionid, mo.startdatetime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY mo.patientid ORDER BY mo.startdatetime ) AS rn FROM medicationorders mo JOIN VancocinCheck vc WHERE (vc.vancocin_count > 0 AND mo.medicationname = 'vancocin') OR (vc.vancocin_count = 0 AND mo.medicationname LIKE '%vancomycin%') GROUP BY mo.patientid, mo.admissionid, mo.startdatetime ), SelectedAdmissions AS ( SELECT patientid, admissionid FROM FirstPrescription WHERE rn = 1 ), UniqueDiagnoses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ad.admissionid, dc.description FROM SelectedAdmissions sa JOIN admissiondiagnoses ad ON ad.admissionid = sa.admissionid JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion ), DiagnosisCounts AS ( SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS diag_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM UniqueDiagnoses GROUP BY description ) SELECT description FROM DiagnosisCounts WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to know the percentage of patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation who were also prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'lopressor' during the same hospital admission, out of the total atrial fibrillation patients. You want the result in percentage (%). You want the result rounded to four decimal places. If no patients were prescribed medication under the exact name 'lopressor,' you want to repeat the same question using medications whose name contains Lopressor's generic name.
gold_sql: WITH af_diagnoses AS ( SELECT d.patientid, d.admissionid, MIN(d.recordeddatetime) AS first_af_time FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN diagnosiscodes dd ON d.icdcode = dd.icdcode AND d.codeversion = dd.codeversion WHERE dd.description LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' GROUP BY d.patientid, d.admissionid ), lopressor_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid, MIN(f.first_af_time) FROM af_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname = 'lopressor' GROUP BY f.patientid ), metoprolol_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid, MIN(f.first_af_time) FROM af_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname LIKE '%metoprolol%' GROUP BY f.patientid ), combined_patients AS ( SELECT patientid FROM lopressor_patients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lopressor_patients) UNION ALL SELECT patientid FROM metoprolol_patients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lopressor_patients) ), total_af_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS total_count FROM af_diagnoses ), medicated_af_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS med_count FROM combined_patients ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT med_count FROM medicated_af_patients) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_af_patients), 4);

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to know the number of male patients diagnosed with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) who were prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'lipitor' during the same hospital admission. gold_sql: WITH ascvd_diagnoses AS ( SELECT d.patientid, d.admissionid, MIN(d.recordeddatetime) AS first_ascvd_time FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN diagnosiscodes dd ON d.icdcode = dd.icdcode AND d.codeversion = dd.codeversion WHERE (dd.codeversion = 10 AND (dd.icdcode LIKE 'I20%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE 'I21%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE 'I22%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE 'I23%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE 'I24%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE 'I25%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE 'I70%')) OR (dd.codeversion = 9 AND (dd.icdcode LIKE '410%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE '411%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE '412%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE '413%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE '414%' OR dd.icdcode LIKE '440%')) GROUP BY d.patientid, d.admissionid ), lipitor_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid, MIN(f.first_ascvd_time) FROM ascvd_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid JOIN demographics dem ON dem.patientid = f.patientid WHERE p.medicationname = 'lipitor' AND dem.gender = 'm' GROUP BY f.patientid ), atorvastatin_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid, MIN(f.first_ascvd_time) FROM ascvd_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid JOIN demographics dem ON dem.patientid = f.patientid WHERE p.medicationname LIKE '%atorvastatin%' AND dem.gender = 'm' GROUP BY f.patientid ), combined_patients AS ( SELECT patientid FROM lipitor_patients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lipitor_patients) UNION ALL SELECT patientid FROM atorvastatin_patients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lipitor_patients) ), medicated_ascvd_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS med_count FROM combined_patients ) SELECT med_count FROM medicated_ascvd_patients;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you first want to identify patients diagnosed with hyperlipidemia. gold_sql: WITH valid_hyperlipidemia_codes AS ( SELECT icdcode, codeversion FROM diagnosiscodes WHERE (icdcode LIKE '2720%' AND codeversion = 9) OR (icdcode LIKE '2721%' AND codeversion = 9) OR (icdcode LIKE '2722%' AND codeversion = 9) OR (icdcode LIKE '2723%' AND codeversion = 9) OR (icdcode LIKE '2724%' AND codeversion = 9) OR (icdcode LIKE 'e780%' AND codeversion = 10) OR (icdcode LIKE 'e781%' AND codeversion = 10) OR (icdcode LIKE 'e782%' AND codeversion = 10) OR (icdcode LIKE 'e783%' AND codeversion = 10) OR (icdcode LIKE 'e784%' AND codeversion = 10) OR (icdcode LIKE 'e785%' AND codeversion = 10) ), hyper_diagnoses AS ( SELECT d.patientid, d.admissionid, MIN(d.recordeddatetime) AS first_hyper_time FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN valid_hyperlipidemia_codes h ON d.icdcode = h.icdcode AND d.codeversion = h.codeversion GROUP BY d.patientid, d.admissionid ), lovastatin_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid FROM hyper_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname = 'lovastatin' AND p.startdatetime >= f.first_hyper_time ), statin_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid FROM hyper_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname IN ('atorvastatin', 'fluvastatin', 'pitavastatin', 'pravastatin', 'rosuvastatin', 'simvastatin', 'rosuvastatin calcium') AND p.startdatetime >= f.first_hyper_time ), combined_patients AS ( SELECT patientid FROM lovastatin_patients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lovastatin_patients) UNION ALL SELECT patientid FROM statin_patients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lovastatin_patients) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS patient_count FROM combined_patients;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. gold_sql: WITH valid_hypertension_codes AS (SELECT DISTINCT ac.icdcode, ac.codeversion, dc.description FROM admissiondiagnoses ac JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ac.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ac.codeversion = dc.codeversion WHERE ((ac.icdcode LIKE '401%' AND ac.codeversion = 9) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE '402%' AND ac.codeversion = 9) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE '403%' AND ac.codeversion = 9) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE '404%' AND ac.codeversion = 9) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE '405%' AND ac.codeversion = 9) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE 'i10%' AND ac.codeversion = 10) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE 'i11%' AND ac.codeversion = 10) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE 'i12%' AND ac.codeversion = 10) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE 'i13%' AND ac.codeversion = 10) OR (ac.icdcode LIKE 'i15%' AND ac.codeversion = 10))), hypertension_diagnoses AS (SELECT DISTINCT ac.patientid, ac.admissionid FROM admissiondiagnoses ac JOIN valid_hypertension_codes vc ON ac.icdcode = vc.icdcode AND ac.codeversion = vc.codeversion), benazepril_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT hd.patientid FROM hypertension_diagnoses hd JOIN medicationorders mo ON mo.admissionid = hd.admissionid WHERE mo.medicationname = 'benazepril'), ace_inhibitor_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT hd.patientid FROM hypertension_diagnoses hd JOIN medicationorders mo ON mo.admissionid = hd.admissionid WHERE mo.medicationname IN ('captopril', 'enalapril maleate', 'lisinopril', 'ramipril')), combined_patients AS (SELECT patientid FROM benazepril_patients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benazepril_patients) UNION ALL SELECT patientid FROM ace_inhibitor_patients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benazepril_patients)), total_hypertension_patients AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS total_count FROM hypertension_diagnoses), medicated_hypertension_patients AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS med_count FROM combined_patients) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT med_count FROM medicated_hypertension_patients) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_hypertension_patients), 4);

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. gold_sql: WITH valid_asthma_codes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.icdcode, d.codeversion, di.description FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN diagnosiscodes di ON d.icdcode = di.icdcode AND d.codeversion = di.codeversion WHERE ((d.icdcode LIKE '493%' AND d.codeversion = 9) OR (d.icdcode LIKE 'j45%' AND d.codeversion = 10)) ), asthma_diagnoses AS ( SELECT d.patientid, d.admissionid, MIN(d.recordeddatetime) AS first_asthma_time FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN valid_asthma_codes c ON d.icdcode = c.icdcode AND d.codeversion = c.codeversion GROUP BY d.patientid, d.admissionid ), levalbuterol_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid FROM asthma_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname = 'levalbuterol' AND p.startdatetime > f.first_asthma_time ), saba_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid FROM asthma_diagnoses f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE ( p.medicationname LIKE '%albuterol%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%terbutaline%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%salbutamol%' ) AND p.medicationname != 'levalbuterol' AND p.startdatetime > f.first_asthma_time ), combined_patients AS ( SELECT patientid FROM levalbuterol_patients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM levalbuterol_patients) UNION ALL SELECT patientid FROM saba_patients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM levalbuterol_patients) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS patient_count FROM combined_patients;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. If no atrial fibrillation patients meeting the above conditions were prescribed a medication whose name contains 'bisoprolol,' you want to ask the same question but for patients prescribed any other selective beta blocker medication instead.
gold_sql: WITH valid_af_codes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.icdcode, d.codeversion, di.description FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN diagnosiscodes di ON d.icdcode = di.icdcode AND d.codeversion = di.codeversion WHERE ( (d.icdcode LIKE '42731%' AND d.codeversion = 9) OR (d.icdcode LIKE 'i480%' AND d.codeversion = 10) OR (d.icdcode LIKE 'i481%' AND d.codeversion = 10) OR (d.icdcode LIKE 'i482%' AND d.codeversion = 10) OR (d.icdcode LIKE 'i4891%' AND d.codeversion = 10) ) ), af_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.patientid, d.admissionid, MIN(d.recordeddatetime) AS first_af_time FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN valid_af_codes h ON d.icdcode = h.icdcode AND d.codeversion = h.codeversion GROUP BY d.patientid, d.admissionid ), bisoprolol_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid FROM af_patients f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE p.medicationname LIKE '%bisoprolol%' ), other_selective_beta_blocker_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.patientid FROM af_patients f JOIN medicationorders p ON p.admissionid = f.admissionid WHERE ( p.medicationname LIKE '%acebutolol%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%atenolol%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%betaxolol%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%celiprolol%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%esmolol%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%metoprolol%' OR p.medicationname LIKE '%nebivolol%' ) ), combined_patients AS ( SELECT patientid FROM bisoprolol_patients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bisoprolol_patients) UNION ALL SELECT patientid FROM other_selective_beta_blocker_patients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bisoprolol_patients) ), total_af_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS total_count FROM af_patients ), medicated_af_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS med_count FROM combined_patients ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT med_count FROM medicated_af_patients) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_af_patients), 4);

instruction: Your goal is to explore patient data related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10007795 and want to know when they were prescribed a statin for hyperlipidemia management after their first hyperlipidemia diagnosis. If the patient was prescribed a statin, you want to know the most recent prescription time after the diagnosis. If the patient was not prescribed any statin, you want to identify whether any other lipid-lowering medication from a different drug class was prescribed. If such medications are found, you want to know the most recent prescription time after the diagnosis. If no such medications are found, end the conversation. You want the answer in the exact time format recorded in the database.
gold_sql: WITH ValidHyperlipidemiaCodes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.icdcode, d.codeversion FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN diagnosiscodes di ON d.icdcode = di.icdcode AND d.codeversion = di.codeversion WHERE ( (d.icdcode IN ('2720', '2721', '2722', '2723', '2724') AND d.codeversion = 9) OR (d.icdcode IN ('e780', 'e781', 'e782', 'e783', 'e784', 'e785') AND d.codeversion = 10) ) ), FirstHyperlipidemiaDiagnosis AS ( SELECT d.patientid, MIN(d.recordeddatetime) AS first_diagnosis_time FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN ValidHyperlipidemiaCodes h ON d.icdcode = h.icdcode AND d.codeversion = h.codeversion WHERE d.patientid = 10007795 GROUP BY d.patientid ), StatinPrescriptions AS ( SELECT p.patientid, MAX(p.startdatetime) AS most_recent_time FROM medicationorders p JOIN FirstHyperlipidemiaDiagnosis fhd ON p.patientid = fhd.patientid WHERE p.medicationname IN ('atorvastatin', 'pravastatin', 'rosuvastatin calcium', 'simvastatin') AND p.startdatetime >= fhd.first_diagnosis_time GROUP BY p.patientid ), NonStatinPrescriptions AS ( SELECT p.patientid, MAX(p.startdatetime) AS most_recent_time FROM medicationorders p JOIN FirstHyperlipidemiaDiagnosis fhd ON p.patientid = fhd.patientid WHERE p.medicationname IN ('ezetimibe', 'fenofibrate', 'gemfibrozil', 'fish oil (omega 3)') AND p.startdatetime >= fhd.first_diagnosis_time GROUP BY p.patientid ), CombinedResult AS ( SELECT most_recent_time, 1 AS priority FROM StatinPrescriptions UNION ALL SELECT most_recent_time, 2 AS priority FROM NonStatinPrescriptions ) SELECT most_recent_time FROM CombinedResult ORDER BY priority, most_recent_time DESC LIMIT 1;

instruction: Your goal is to explore patient data related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10021312 and want to know when they were prescribed an SSRI for major depressive disorder (MDD) treatment after their first MDD diagnosis. If the patient was prescribed an SSRI, you want to know the most recent prescription time after the diagnosis. If the patient was not prescribed any SSRI, you want to identify whether any other class of medications commonly prescribed in the context of MDD treatment was prescribed after the first MDD diagnosis. If such medications are found, you want to know the most recent prescription time. If no such medications are found, end the conversation. You want the answer in the exact time format recorded in the database.
gold_sql: WITH FirstMDDDiagnosis AS ( SELECT ad.patientid, MIN(ad.recordeddatetime) AS first_diagnosis_time FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion WHERE ad.patientid = 10021312 AND dc.description LIKE '%major depressive disorder%' GROUP BY ad.patientid ), SSRIPrescriptions AS ( SELECT mo.patientid, MAX(mo.startdatetime) AS most_recent_time FROM medicationorders mo JOIN FirstMDDDiagnosis fd ON mo.patientid = fd.patientid WHERE mo.medicationname IN ( 'fluoxetine', 'sertraline', 'paroxetine', 'escitalopram', 'citalopram' ) AND mo.startdatetime > fd.first_diagnosis_time GROUP BY mo.patientid ), OtherMDDMedications AS ( SELECT mo.patientid, MAX(mo.startdatetime) AS most_recent_time FROM medicationorders mo JOIN FirstMDDDiagnosis fd ON mo.patientid = fd.patientid WHERE mo.medicationname IN ( 'venlafaxine', 'duloxetine', 'bupropion', 'mirtazapine', 'trazodone', 'amitriptyline', 'nortriptyline', 'gabapentin', 'divalproex (extended release)', 'ziprasidone hydrochloride' ) AND mo.startdatetime > fd.first_diagnosis_time GROUP BY mo.patientid ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SSRIPrescriptions) THEN (SELECT most_recent_time FROM SSRIPrescriptions) WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OtherMDDMedications) THEN (SELECT most_recent_time FROM OtherMDDMedications) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: Your goal is to find the number of patients who may be eligible for a clinical study on drug-induced GI bleeding. instruction: Your goal is to find the number of patients who may be eligible for a clinical study on comorbidity burden in chronic kidney disease. instruction: Your goal is to find the number of patients who may be eligible for a clinical study on sepsis-induced coagulopathy. You want to include patients who meet all of the inclusion criteria and do not meet any of the exclusion criteria listed below during the same hospital admission. Inclusion Criteria: 1. Breathing rate greater than 20 breaths per minute 2. Arterial systolic blood pressure less than 90 mmHg 3. At least one of the following: - Heart rate greater than 100 beats per minute - Abnormal body temperature (greater than 38°C or less than 36°C) 4. Diagnosed with disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) Exclusion Criteria: 1. Chronic lung disease: Diagnosed with COPD or interstitial lung disease 2. Heart failure: Diagnosed with congestive or chronic heart failure 3. Age less than 18 years If no patients meet the above criteria, you want to modify inclusion criterion 4 to: patients diagnosed with any other organ dysfunction commonly associated with sepsis. If still no patients are found, end the conversation. If certain conditions are missing from the database, you may ignore them. If the database contains age information at the time of hospital admission, you want to use that information directly without calculating age. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients → one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH InclusionRR AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ce.patientid, ce.admissionid FROM clinicalevents ce JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname = 'respiratory rate' AND ce.value > 20 ), InclusionSBP AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ce.patientid, ce.admissionid FROM clinicalevents ce JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname = 'arterial blood pressure systolic' AND ce.value < 90 ), InclusionHR AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ce.patientid, ce.admissionid FROM clinicalevents ce JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname = 'heart rate' AND ce.value > 100 ), InclusionTemp AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ce.patientid, ce.admissionid FROM clinicalevents ce JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname = 'temperature celsius' AND (ce.value > 38 OR ce.value < 36) ), HemodynamicPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT rr.patientid, rr.admissionid FROM InclusionRR rr JOIN InclusionSBP sbp ON rr.admissionid = sbp.admissionid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM InclusionHR hr WHERE hr.admissionid = rr.admissionid UNION SELECT 1 FROM InclusionTemp temp WHERE temp.admissionid = rr.admissionid ) ), ExclusionLungDisease AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ad.admissionid FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion WHERE dc.description LIKE '%chronic obstructive pulmonary%' OR dc.description LIKE '%obstructive chronic bronchitis%' OR dc.description LIKE '%chronic airway obstruction%' OR dc.description LIKE '%interstitial lung disease%' ), ExclusionHeartFailure AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ad.admissionid FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion WHERE dc.description LIKE '%heart failure%' AND (dc.description LIKE '%congestive%' OR dc.description LIKE '%chronic%') ), ExclusionAge AS ( SELECT DISTINCT admissionid FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE age < 18 ), EligiblePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT hp.patientid, hp.admissionid FROM HemodynamicPatients hp WHERE hp.admissionid NOT IN (SELECT admissionid FROM ExclusionLungDisease) AND hp.admissionid NOT IN (SELECT admissionid FROM ExclusionHeartFailure) AND hp.admissionid NOT IN (SELECT admissionid FROM ExclusionAge) ), EligibleWithDIC AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patientid) AS patient_count FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN admissiondiagnoses ad ON ep.admissionid = ad.admissionid JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion WHERE dc.description LIKE '%disseminated intravascular%' ), EligibleWithOtherOrganDysfunction AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patientid) AS patient_count FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN admissiondiagnoses ad ON ep.admissionid = ad.admissionid JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion WHERE ( dc.description LIKE '%septic shock%' OR dc.description LIKE '%sepsis%' OR dc.description LIKE '%acute kidney%' OR dc.description LIKE '%acute respiratory distress%' OR dc.description LIKE '%organ failure%' OR dc.description LIKE '%lactic acidosis%') AND dc.description NOT LIKE '%disseminated intravascular%' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithDIC) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithDIC) WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherOrganDysfunction) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherOrganDysfunction) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: Your goal is to find the number of patients who may be eligible for a clinical study on coagulopathy reversal strategies in critically ill patients requiring red blood cell transfusion. You want to include patients who meet all of the inclusion criteria listed below during the same hospital admission: Inclusion Criteria: 1. Received a blood transfusion (Packed Red Blood Cells or whole blood) 2. At least two of the following laboratory abnormalities: - INR greater than 1.5 - Platelet count less than 150,000/μL - Hemoglobin less than 10 g/dL 3. Administered prothrombin complex concentrate (PCC) as a coagulopathy reversal agent If no patients meet all of the above criteria, you want to modify inclusion criterion 3 to: patients who received any other pharmacological or blood product-based agent commonly used for coagulopathy reversal in critically ill patients. If still no patients are found, end the conversation. If certain laboratory tests are not available in the database, you should still require at least two abnormalities among the tests that are available. Do not confuse the use of 'and' and 'or' when describing the conditions. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients → one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH TransfusedAdmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ir.patientid, ir.admissionid FROM intakerecords ir JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ir.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname IN ('packed red blood cells', 'packed red cells', 'whole blood') ), AbnormalINR AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lr.patientid, lr.admissionid FROM labresults lr JOIN labtesttypes ltt ON lr.itemcode = ltt.itemcode WHERE ltt.itemname LIKE '%inr%' AND lr.resultvalue > 1.5 ), LowPlatelets AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lr.patientid, lr.admissionid FROM labresults lr JOIN labtesttypes ltt ON lr.itemcode = ltt.itemcode WHERE ltt.itemname LIKE '%platelet%' AND ( (lr.resultunit = 'k/ul' AND lr.resultvalue < 150) OR (lr.resultunit = 'ul' AND lr.resultvalue < 150000)) ), LowHemoglobin AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lr.patientid, lr.admissionid FROM labresults lr JOIN labtesttypes ltt ON lr.itemcode = ltt.itemcode WHERE ltt.itemname = 'hemoglobin' AND ( (lr.resultunit = 'g/dl' AND lr.resultvalue < 10) OR (lr.resultunit = 'g/l' AND lr.resultvalue < 100)) ), EligiblePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ta.patientid, ta.admissionid FROM TransfusedAdmissions ta WHERE (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AbnormalINR i WHERE i.admissionid = ta.admissionid) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LowPlatelets p WHERE p.admissionid = ta.admissionid) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LowHemoglobin h WHERE h.admissionid = ta.admissionid) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ), EligibleWithPCC AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patientid) AS patient_count FROM EligiblePatients ep WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medicationorders mo WHERE mo.admissionid = ep.admissionid AND ( mo.medicationname LIKE '%prothrombin complex%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%kcentra%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%bebulin%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%profilnine%')) ), EligibleWithOtherReversal AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patientid) AS patient_count FROM EligiblePatients ep WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medicationorders mo WHERE mo.admissionid = ep.admissionid AND ( mo.medicationname LIKE '%phytonadione%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%vitamin k%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%desmopressin%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%protamine%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%tranexamic%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%aminocaproic%') AND mo.medicationname NOT LIKE '%prothrombin complex%' AND mo.medicationname NOT LIKE '%kcentra%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM intakerecords ir JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ir.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE ir.admissionid = ep.admissionid AND ( cit.itemname LIKE '%fresh frozen plasma%' OR cit.itemname LIKE '%cryoprecipitate%' OR cit.itemname LIKE '%platelets%')) ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithPCC) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithPCC) WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherReversal) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherReversal) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: Your goal is to find the number of patients who may be eligible for a clinical study on targeted anti-MRSA therapy in ICU pneumonia. Diagnosed with pneumonia 2. Required ICU admission during the same hospital admission 3. Received linezolid as targeted anti-MRSA therapy Exclusion Criteria: 1. Diagnosed with aspiration pneumonia or aspiration pneumonitis You want different variants of pneumonia (e.g., bacterial pneumonia, Klebsiella pneumonia, ventilator-associated pneumonia) treated as a single diagnosis category. gold_sql: WITH PneumoniaICUAdmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ad.patientid, ad.admissionid FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN icuepisodes icu ON ad.admissionid = icu.admissionid WHERE dc.description LIKE '%pneumonia%' AND dc.description NOT LIKE '%aspiration%' AND ad.patientid NOT IN ( SELECT ad2.patientid FROM admissiondiagnoses ad2 JOIN diagnosiscodes dc2 ON ad2.icdcode = dc2.icdcode AND ad2.codeversion = dc2.codeversion WHERE dc2.description LIKE '%pneumonitis due to inhalation%' OR dc2.description LIKE '%aspiration pneumonia%' OR dc2.description LIKE '%aspiration pneumonitis%' ) ), EligibleWithLinezolid AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patientid) AS patient_count FROM PneumoniaICUAdmissions p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medicationorders mo WHERE mo.admissionid = p.admissionid AND mo.medicationname LIKE '%linezolid%' ) ), EligibleWithOtherAntiMRSA AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patientid) AS patient_count FROM PneumoniaICUAdmissions p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medicationorders mo WHERE mo.admissionid = p.admissionid AND ( (mo.medicationname LIKE '%vancomycin%' AND mo.medicationname NOT LIKE '%oral%') OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%trimethoprim%sulfamethoxazole%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%bactrim%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%doxycycline%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%clindamycin%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%daptomycin%' OR mo.medicationname LIKE '%teicoplanin%' ) AND mo.medicationname NOT LIKE '%linezolid%' ) ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithLinezolid) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithLinezolid) WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherAntiMRSA) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherAntiMRSA) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to patient diagnoses. Specifically, you want to find the three most frequently recorded diagnosis names in the emergency information table. instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to patient allergies. Specifically, you first want to identify allergies from the allergy_list table. If the allergy_list table exists in the database, find the top 5 most common allergy descriptions recorded there. gold_sql: WITH allergy_descriptions AS ( SELECT dd.description, COUNT(*) AS frequency FROM admissiondiagnoses d JOIN diagnosiscodes dd ON d.icdcode = dd.icdcode AND d.codeversion = dd.codeversion WHERE dd.description LIKE '%allergy%' OR dd.description LIKE '%hypersensitivity%' GROUP BY dd.description ), ranked_descriptions AS ( SELECT description, frequency, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS rnk FROM allergy_descriptions ) SELECT description FROM ranked_descriptions WHERE rnk <= 5 ORDER BY frequency DESC, description ASC;
